s0D8000.name: Map16 tile definitions (8 bytes per tile)
summary: Map16 16x16 block definitions, 8 bytes each: four (8x8 character, property) pairs in the order top-left, bottom-left,
top-right, bottom-right. Property byte is YXPCCCTT (Y/X flip, priority, palette, GFX page).
The level loader (bank 05, via the bit mask at $05:81BB) copies the shared tiles from here and picks the tileset-specific
part from $0D8B70/$0DBC00/$0DC800/$0DD400/$0DE300 (TilesetMAP16Loc). So a row's Map16 number is not simply (addr-$8000)/8.
Each row below is decoded as chr/prop for the four quarters. $0DA0A0-$0DA0F8 is $FF padding.

PtrsLong0DA50F.name: Bushes pointer; screen exit and jump objects
summary: Last standard object pointer (bushes 1 through 5), followed by the two extended object routines at index $00 and $01.
Screen exit (CODE_0DA512): reads the destination screen byte from the level data, stores it in $19B8,X (X = screen), water flag in $19D8,X,

s0DA100.name: Load extended object
summary: Entry point (JSL) for extended level objects. Takes the extended object number in [$59] as index into the pointer table at $0DA10F.
Parameters: [$59]: extended object number. Quirk: redundant SEP #$30 and a JSR wrapper around a JSL dispatch.

s0DA548.name: Table: Map16 tile numbers for single-tile objects
summary: Indexed by extended object number minus $10. Gives the Map16 tile (low byte) written by CODE_0DA57B.
Indexes from $13 up use the high Map16 page ($100+).

s0DA57B.name: Draw single-tile extended objects
summary: Writes one Map16 tile for extended objects $10 and up (doors, invisible blocks, berries, turn blocks, ? blocks, corner edges, ...).
Skips the invisible 1UP and 3-UP moon if already collected in this level, and replaces item-memory objects that were already hit by a used block.
Parameters: X: extended object number; Y/[$57]: tile position in the level buffer. Writes through [$6B],Y.
CODE_0DA64D: generates the green star block by entering the middle of the routine with index $32.

s0DA656.name: Draw small slopes (unused objects)
summary: Draws a two-tile-wide small slope for extended objects $42/$43: left tile then right tile.
Parameters: X: extended object number ($42 or $43); Y/[$57]: position.

s0DA673.name: Draw triangles, midway point and pointer helpers
summary: Purple triangle (extended objects $44/$45): top tile from table, bottom tile always $EB.
Midway point (CODE_0DA68E): draws the midway rope tiles unless the midway flag is already set.
CODE_0DA6B1/CODE_0DA6BA: save and restore the level data pointer ($6B/$6C -> $04/$05) and the current screen number.

s0DA6D1.name: Draw two-tile-high door
summary: Extended objects $47 and up: writes a top tile and, one row below, a bottom tile from the tables at $0DA6CD/$0DA6CF.
Also reached by the unused objects $98-$FF, which index past the table and draw garbage.
